turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: The three campaigns with the most ad spend in September 2026 (1 to 30 September) were Search NL always-on (3,870.00 EUR), Social TR spring (2,100.00 EUR) and Newsletter monthly (300.00 EUR), so the top one spent 3,870.00 EUR; the second and third campaign names held extra text that I ignored.
